Company: Signal Processing Engineer (RF Processing & Analytics)
Title: Drone System Validation Engineer Intern
Location: Paris
Visa: 
About Us Harmattan AI is a next-generation defense prime building autonomous and scalable defense systems. Following the close of a $200M Series B, valuing the company at $1.4 billion, we are expanding our teams and capabilities to deliver mission-critical systems to allied forces. Our work is guided by clear values: building technologies with real-world impact, pursuing excellence in everything we do, setting ambitious goals, and taking on the hardest technical challenges. We operate in a demanding environment where rigor, ownership, and execution are expected. About the Role As a Drone System Validation Engineer Intern, you will own one well-defined validation topic for six months within our Validation team in Paris or Lausanne. Your topic is agreed during the interview process and fitted to your profile. You will work hands-on with our autonomous drone systems across simulation, lab, bench and flight testing.
